parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time in ISO 8601 format in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 3 days.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PlayUrl
parameters.description: The live streaming URL. You can specify multiple URLs separated by commas (,), up to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time in ISO 8601 format in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The start time must be within the last 3 days.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:
- complete: completed.
- pending: waiting for preload.
- preloading: preloading in progress.
- failed: preload failed.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The task ID. You can obtain the preload task ID by calling the [SetLiveStreamPreloadTasks](~~2519938~~) operation.
